title: Audit current data plan
summary: Added the Audit current-data implementation plan, made latest audit CSV resolution prefer completed audit progress evidence and timestamped report names, and promoted active probe-cache replacement-file coverage.
reason: Reports Audit needed an explicit plan for all audit-owned features plus stronger guards against stale report selection and stale probe-cache reuse for replaced video files.
behavior_before: The Reports audit preview selected the newest audit CSV by filesystem mtime, so an older report touched later could become the displayed latest audit. Active PowerShell guard coverage did not directly assert same-path replacement files get a different audit probe-cache identity.
behavior_after: The latest audit CSV resolver prefers completed audit_progress.json report pointers inside the audit report root, falls back to audit_summary timestamp ordering before mtime, and active PowerShell tests assert a same-path, same-size, same-mtime fixture with different sampled content produces a different probe-cache identity. The plan records that fallback completion proof and exhaustive replacement identity remain open work.
rollback_plan: Revert the status_files.py resolver changes and the added test assertions/docs plan; the previous mtime-only CSV selection and existing probe-cache implementation would be restored without media mutation.
